title: Interactive Gambling Amendment (Banning Social Casinos and Other Measures) Bill 2020
short_title: Interactive Gambling Amendment (Banning Social Casinos and Other Measures) Bill 2020

speeches.speaker: Graham Perrett
speeches.brief: Adam Bandt introduced the Green New Deal (Quit Coal and Renew Australia) Bill 2020 to establish Renew Australia and restrict thermal coal activities. Andrew Wilkie introduced the Interactive Gambling Amendment (Banning Social Casinos and Other Measures) Bill 2020 to amend the Interactive Gambling Act 2001.

speeches.speaker: Andrew Wilkie
speeches.brief: The Interactive Gambling Amendment (Banning Social Casinos and Other Measures) Bill 2020 would make providing social casino services to Australians a criminal and civil offence, and give ACMA power to seek injunctions blocking access to illegal gambling sites and related search results. The speech cited Australians losing over $1,200 per capita annually, around 400 gambling-related suicides per year, and a 114% rise in online gambling during COVID, while criticising the NSW government’s push to reopen poker machine venues and urging measures such as $1 maximum bets, slower spins, and precommitment systems.
